title: Healthy Life: adaptive routines, learning paths and quiet hours
summary: Extend the working wellness workspace with per-date adaptations, exercise learning paths, study focus notes, daily knowledge and more detailed insights.

changes.detail: Optional lighter-day preview, date-specific duration changes, conflict-checked rescheduling and activity check-in undo. Planner weekday preferences and independent preference saving.
Four self-paced exercise education paths with persisted difficulty and learning progress; daily knowledge rotation and nutrition myth/warm-up lessons with primary sources.
Study activity opens Focus with its task; editable persistent distraction notes. Illustrated overview, labeled calendar counts and per-habit weekly insights.
Quiet hours now suppress native schedules and browser delivery/catch-up and are reflected in next-reminder previews. Quiet-hours inputs are user-controlled.

validation.name: Regression and visual QA
validation.detail: Pending focused tests, lint and browser export/interaction checks. No deployment authorized or performed.
